title: contracts/startup.json
description: The app's facts about its startup, read by app-startup-and-bootstrap's check-startup. Every key is optional.

rootLayout.description: The Expo Router root layout (default <routesDir>/_layout.tsx): the error net and the splash hold are its first imports, and it renders DirectionGate.

appRoot.description: The component that does the startup work with effects and mounts the providers (default <featuresDir>/root-navigator/app-root.tsx). Without it the root layout plays both parts.

rootStack.description: The component above the root navigator (default <featuresDir>/root-navigator/root-stack.tsx): the gesture root, MotionConfig, the navigation theme and the Stack.

appRootOrder.description: JSX elements on the root path (the app root and the local provider components it renders, such as AppProviders or PreferencesRoot), outermost first; each listed element that is present must sit inside every earlier listed element that is present, and each is mounted once. A|B accepts either name.

rootStackOrder.description: The same for the root stack file (default GestureHandlerRootView, KeyboardProvider, MotionConfig|RootMotion, NavigationThemeProvider, SessionProvider, AppFeedback|FeedbackProvider, AdsRoot, GamesRoot, AppStack|Stack); each is mounted once on the root path.

maxBlockingMs.description: The longest deadline createStartupGate may give blocking startup tasks (default 3000).

lifecycleFiles.description: Globs of files allowed to write from an AppState listener (default: the root flush hook). Every other buffered writer hands a Flusher to the app root.

openCalls.description: Functions that open the data layer (default openDeviceData): each is called once in app code, in the app root's startup initializer.
